title: The morphological and anatomical variability of the stems of an industrial hemp collection and the properties of its fibres
scope: Cannabis sativa stem morphology and cross-sectional anatomy, including peripheral bast fiber bundles, xylem-rich inner tissues, lignification gradients, internode traits, and genotype-dependent structural variation.

title: Studying Secondary Growth and Bast Fiber Development: The Hemp Hypocotyl Peeks behind the Wall
scope: Cannabis sativa primary-to-secondary growth transition, vascular cambium activity, secondary xylem development, phloem bast fibers, cell-wall maturation, and radial thickening in hemp hypocotyl tissue.

title: Challenges and advances in measuring sap flow in agriculture and agroforestry: A review with focus on nuclear magnetic resonance
scope: Plant hydraulics, soil-plant-atmosphere water movement, cohesion-tension description of xylem sap ascent, transpiration-linked water-potential gradients, and methods used to observe sap flow.

title: Maintenance of xylem Network Transport Capacity: A Review of Embolism Repair in Vascular Plants
scope: Vascular-plant xylem transport capacity, drought-induced and wound-associated embolism, hydraulic conductivity loss, cavitation resistance, and the evidence limits surrounding embolism repair mechanisms.
